google_auth.title: 👀 Google credentials
google_auth.description: Place here the full contents of the credentials JSON key file

spreadsheet_id.title: 🆔 Google spreadsheet id
spreadsheet_id.description: From the target spreadsheet URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<copy this>/edit...

accounts_sheet_config.title: 📊 Accounts sheet config
accounts_sheet_config.description: Imported: instructions to grab the accounts from - overrides the next field

brezzels_accounts.title: 🥨 Brezzels accounts list
brezzels_accounts.description: Manual: Login details and share % for every account you want to include in the report

report_from.title: 🗓️ Report from
report_from.description: Profits and other operations start at this date (previous values will be ignored)

dbg_only_validations.title: Only perform validations
dbg_only_validations.description: If enabled, just audits the input fields - the spreadsheet is not modified

dbg_skip_sheets_config.title: Skip sheets configuration
dbg_skip_sheets_config.description: If enabled, omits the initial set up for the model accounts sheets

dbg_skip_stats_grabbing.title: Skip stats grabbing
dbg_skip_stats_grabbing.description: If enabled, omits downloading the model accounts most recent earnings

dbg_lazy_report.title: Lazy report
dbg_lazy_report.description: If enabled, only updates the last period rows in each model account sheet

dbg_request_cooldown.title: 🧯 API request cooldown
dbg_request_cooldown.description: Time to wait after every API request (0: no waiting)

dbg_operation_threads.title: 🤹 API operation threads
dbg_operation_threads.description: Amount of simultaneous tasks for API operations (when applicable)

dbg_operation_lives.title: 🆙 API operation lives
dbg_operation_lives.description: Total tries for each API operation before failing (1: no retries)

dbg_backoff_factor.title: ✳️ API backoff factor
dbg_backoff_factor.description: A multiplier for the number of seconds to wait for the next retry

adv_proxy_usage.title: Proxy usage
adv_proxy_usage.description: Proxies used to anonymize your requests
